title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Xion USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns Noble's full USDC escrow for Xion (67,319.812450 USDC, Noble channel-113) to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG over channel-2 (MsgReturnToNoble with that explicit amount), covering all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/F082B65C88E4B6D5EF1DB243CDA1D331D002759E938A0F5CD3FFDC5D53B3E349) still in circulation on Xion. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
